change: Verify same-page image candidates in batches of at most two; collect fulfilled candidates in their original source ranking.

newCoverage: Both candidates start before either finishes; peak concurrency is two
Faster lower-ranked responses cannot displace higher-ranked valid images
Only two images and four candidates per page; no unused second source request
Cancellation aborts both pending checks without scheduling a third
Synthetic sequential/parallel delayed responses produce identical selected references

syntheticTiming.interpretation: Demonstrates overlap of independent waits in this controlled path, not a production whole-planet speedup estimate. Wall-clock values are diagnostics rather than a timing-sensitive pass criterion.
